title: Transfer retained work to another local environment
goal: Make selected operational history usable in another environment of the same project.
context: A second engineering checkout exists without the selected local work history.
trigger: The maintainer selects retained work for transfer.
preconditions: The actor explicitly identifies the project and intended scope.
Any requested mutation is subject to applicable project authority.

interaction.action: Selects the retained scope and receiving project environment.
Reports project association, scope, artifact availability and destination conflicts.
Reports the resulting retained scope and exclusions at the receiver while leaving the source available.

expected_outcome: The receiving environment can inspect the selected work with original provenance and required evidence.

alternatives.condition: Only a selected portion of history is transferred.
alternatives.outcome: The receiver sees the exclusions and does not mistake the received scope for the entire history.

failures.condition: Project identity differs or destination histories conflict.
failures.outcome: The system stops without silent reassignment, merging or overwrite.
The result reports failure or incompleteness and does not claim the selected work is fully recoverable.

sources.basis: Draft derivation from the refined IRs and RR proposal; no approval, implementation or satisfaction claim.
